scripts.dev: concurrently -n MCP,API,WEB -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @enterprise/mcp-server" "npm run dev -w @enterprise/api-server" "npm run dev -w @enterprise/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @enterprise/shared && npm run build -w @enterprise/mcp-server && npm run build -w @enterprise/api-server && npm run build -w @enterprise/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @enterprise/mcp-server && npm run test -w @enterprise/api-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @enterprise/shared && npm run typecheck -w @enterprise/mcp-server && npm run typecheck -w @enterprise/api-server && npm run typecheck -w @enterprise/web
